ask: GitHub Actions. .github/workflows/ci.yml: CI for a Python+Node repo — matrix on 3.11/3.12, dependency caching, lint job with ruff, type check job with mypy, test job with coverage upload, build artifacts, and a final gate job that depends on all. write the file.

files.ci.yml:
name: CI

on:
  push:
    branches: ["main", "master"]
  pull_request:
    branches: ["main", "master"]

concurrency:
  group: ${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: true

jobs:
  # ── Lint ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  lint:
    name: Lint (ruff)
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        python-version: ["3.11", "3.12"]

    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up Python ${{ matrix.python-version }}
        uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: ${{ matrix.python-version }}

      - name: Cache pip
        uses: actions/cache@v4
        with:
          path: ~/.cache/pip
          key: pip-lint-${{ matrix.python-version }}-${{ hashFiles('**/requirements*.txt', '**/pyproject.toml') }}
          restore-keys: |
            pip-lint-${{ matrix.python-version }}-
            pip-lint-

      - name: Install ruff
        run: pip install --upgrade ruff

      - name: Run ruff
        run: ruff check . --output-format=github

  # ── Type-check ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  typecheck:
    name: Type-check (mypy)
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        python-version: ["3.11", "3.12"]

    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up Python ${{ matrix.python-version }}
        uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: ${{ matrix.python-version }}

      - name: Cache pip
        uses: actions/cache@v4
        with:
          path: ~/.cache/pip
          key: pip-typecheck-${{ matrix.python-version }}-${{ hashFiles('**/requirements*.txt', '**/pyproject.toml') }}
          restore-keys: |
            pip-typecheck-${{ matrix.python-version }}-
            pip-typecheck-

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: |
          pip install --upgrade pip
          pip install mypy
          if [ -f requirements.txt ]; then pip install -r requirements.txt; fi
          if [ -f requirements-dev.txt ]; then pip install -r requirements-dev.txt; fi

      - name: Run mypy
        run: mypy . --ignore-missing-imports

  # ── Test ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  test:
    name: Test (Python ${{ matrix.python-version }})
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        python-version: ["3.11", "3.12"]

    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up Python ${{ matrix.python-version }}
        uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: ${{ matrix.python-version }}

      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: lts/*
          cache: npm
          cache-dependency-path: "**/package-lock.json"

      - name: Cache pip
        uses: actions/cache@v4
        with:
          path: ~/.cache/pip
          key: pip-test-${{ matrix.python-version }}-${{ hashFiles('**/requirements*.txt', '**/pyproject.toml') }}
          restore-keys: |
            pip-test-${{ matrix.python-version }}-
            pip-test-

      - name: Install Python dependencies
        run: |
          pip install --upgrade pip
          pip install pytest pytest-cov
          if [ -f requirements.txt ]; then pip install -r requirements.txt; fi
          if [ -f requirements-dev.txt ]; then pip install -r requirements-dev.txt; fi

      - name: Install Node dependencies
        run: npm ci

      - name: Run Python tests with coverage
        run: |
          pytest \
            --cov \
            --cov-report=xml:coverage-${{ matrix.python-version }}.xml \
            --cov-report=term-missing \
            -v

      - name: Run Node tests
        run: npm test

      - name: Upload coverage report
        uses: codecov/codecov-action@v4
        with:
          files: coverage-${{ matrix.python-version }}.xml
          flags: python-${{ matrix.python-version }}
          fail_ci_if_error: false

  # ── Build artifacts ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  build:
    name: Build artifacts
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    needs: [lint, typecheck, test]

    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up Python 3.12
        uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: "3.12"

      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: lts/*
          cache: npm
          cache-dependency-path: "**/package-lock.json"

      - name: Cache pip
        uses: actions/cache@v4
        with:
          path: ~/.cache/pip
          key: pip-build-3.12-${{ hashFiles('**/requirements*.txt', '**/pyproject.toml') }}
          restore-keys: |
            pip-build-3.12-

      - name: Install Python build deps
        run: |
          pip install --upgrade pip build
          if [ -f requirements.txt ]; then pip install -r requirements.txt; fi

      - name: Install Node dependencies
        run: npm ci

      - name: Build Python package
        run: python -m build

      - name: Build Node assets
        run: npm run build --if-present

      - name: Upload Python dist
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: python-dist
          path: dist/
          retention-days: 7

      - name: Upload Node build output
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: node-dist
          path: |
            dist/
            build/
          retention-days: 7

  # ── Gate ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  gate:
    name: All checks passed
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    needs: [lint, typecheck, test, build]
    if: always()

    steps:
      - name: Check all jobs succeeded
        run: |
          if [[ "${{ needs.lint.result }}"      != "success" || \
                "${{ needs.typecheck.result }}" != "success" || \
                "${{ needs.test.result }}"      != "success" || \
                "${{ needs.build.result }}"     != "success" ]]; then
            echo "One or more required jobs did not succeed."
            echo "lint:      ${{ needs.lint.result }}"
            echo "typecheck: ${{ needs.typecheck.result }}"
            echo "test:      ${{ needs.test.result }}"
            echo "build:     ${{ needs.build.result }}"
            exit 1
          fi
          echo "All required jobs passed."

prose:
The file is written. Here's what `.github/workflows/ci.yml` covers:

- **Triggers** on push and PR to main/master, with concurrency cancellation so superseded runs don't pile up.
- **Matrix** across Python 3.11 and 3.12 for lint, typecheck, and test jobs.
- **Caching** keyed on Python version plus a hash of `requirements*.txt` and `pyproject.toml`, with partial restore-key fallbacks so cold caches degrade gracefully.
- **Lint** runs `ruff check . --output-format=github` so findings map to PR annotations.
- **Type-check** installs project deps before running `mypy`, using `--ignore-missing-imports` to avoid noise from untyped third-party packages.
- **Test** sets up both Python and Node, installs deps via `pip` and `npm ci`, runs pytest with coverage (XML + terminal) and `npm test`, then uploads coverage to Codecov flagged per Python version.
- **Build** runs after lint, typecheck, and test pass, builds the Python wheel/sdist with `python -m build` and Node assets via `npm run build`, and uploads both as named artifacts with 7-day retention.
- **Gate** depends on all four jobs and uses `if: always()` so it runs even on failure, then explicitly checks each result and fails the workflow if any required job didn't succeed.

A couple of assumptions baked in: coverage goes to Codecov (needs `CODECOV_TOKEN` in repo secrets for private repos), `npm run build` exists for the Node side, and mypy runs against the whole repo. If your package layout differs or you want mypy scoped to a src directory, that line is the one to adjust.
